overreach: Wi‑Fi 7/8 push Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer needs toward wider bandwidth, multi-channel/MIMO operation, and deeper per-link modulation analysis
Wi‑Fi 7 requires support for 320 MHz channel bandwidth
generator/analyzer capability must cover high-order WLAN modulation
UEQM analysis must assess whether the device adapts modulation correctly
the safest supported floor is 320 MHz and 4096QAM for Wi‑Fi 7/8 core PHY

review.reason: The main conclusions are a fair synthesis of the cited passages: Wi‑Fi 7/8 features such as 320 MHz bandwidth, 4096QAM, MLO, MIMO, dRU and UEQM are cited, and the answer reasonably maps them to generator/analyzer capability needs. Some wording turns cited feature descriptions or planned demonstrations into stronger requirement/past-tense statements, but this does not undermine the overall answer.
